summary: Known community.docker issue: docker_container's per-network MAC address may be ignored when the network is attached after container creation.
questions: Why isn't my docker_container MAC address applied in Ansible 11?

answer_card.title: docker_container MAC address may be ignored
answer_card.answer_md: When a network with a specified MAC address is attached after the container is created (for example, during idempotency handling), the Docker daemon may ignore the MAC address.
